import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] power10 = new long[17];

    static String to_string(BigInteger x) {
        if (x.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) return "0";
        String s = x.toString();
        return s;
    }

    static void solve_with_sum(List<Integer> coeffs, int base, BigInteger[] result) {
        int n = coeffs.size();
        List<Integer> left_part = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> right_part = new ArrayList<>();
        
        class DFS {
            void left_dfs(int idx, int cur) {
                if (idx == n / 2) {
                    left_part.add((cur + base) % MOD);
                    return;
                }
                left_dfs(idx + 1, cur);
                left_dfs(idx + 1, (cur + coeffs.get(idx)) % MOD);
            }
            
            void right_dfs(int idx, int cur) {
                if (idx == n) {
                    right_part.add(cur);
                    return;
                }
                right_dfs(idx + 1, cur);
                right_dfs(idx + 1, (cur + coeffs.get(idx)) % MOD);
            }
        }
        
        DFS dfs = new DFS();
        dfs.left_dfs(0, 0);
        dfs.right_dfs(n / 2, 0);
        
        Collections.sort(left_part);
        Collections.sort(right_part);
        
        long sum_right = 0;
        for (int x : right_part) sum_right = (sum_right + x) % MOD;
        
        int j = right_part.size() - 1;
        for (int x : left_part) {
            while (j >= 0 && (x + right_part.get(j)) >= MOD) --j;
            result[0] = result[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf((long)x * right_part.size()))
                    .add(BigInteger.valueOf(sum_right))
                    .subtract(BigInteger.valueOf((long)(right_part.size() - 1 - j) * MOD));
        }
    }

    static long count_prefix_numbers(String prefix, long max_val, String n_str) {
        long val = 0;
        for (char c : prefix.toCharArray()) val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
        
        long count = 0;
        int plen = prefix.length();
        int nlen = n_str.length();
        
        for (int len = plen; len <= nlen; ++len) {
            if (len < nlen) {
                count += power10[len - plen];
            } else {
                if (prefix.compareTo(n_str) < 0) {
                    count += power10[len - plen];
                } else if (prefix.equals(n_str)) {
                    count += max_val - val * power10[nlen - plen] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        
        String ns;
        if (n == 0) ns = "0";
        else {
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            long t = n;
            while (t > 0) {
                sb.append((char)('0' + (t % 10)));
                t /= 10;
            }
            ns = sb.reverse().toString();
        }
        
        power10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) power10[i] = power10[i-1] * 10;
        
        BigInteger[] answer = new BigInteger[1];
        answer[0] = BigInteger.ZERO;
        
        for (int length = 1; length <= ns.length(); ++length) {
            for (int diff_index = 0; diff_index < Math.min(length, ns.length()); ++diff_index) {
                String current = "";
                long value = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < diff_index; ++i) {
                    current += ns.charAt(i);
                    value = value * 10 + (ns.charAt(i) - '0');
                }
                
                for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; ++digit) {
                    if (diff_index == 0 && digit == 0) continue;
                    if (diff_index < ns.length() && digit == ns.charAt(diff_index) - '0') continue;
                    if (length == ns.length() && digit > ns.charAt(diff_index) - '0') continue;
                    
                    String new_current = current + (char)('0' + digit);
                    long new_value = value * 10 + digit;
                    
                    long base = 0;
                    String temp = "";
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < new_current.length(); ++i) {
                        char start_char = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char c = start_char; c < new_current.charAt(i); ++c) {
                            base += count_prefix_numbers(temp + c, n, ns);
                        }
                        temp += new_current.charAt(i);
                    }
                    base += new_current.length() - 1;
                    
                    List<Integer> variables = new ArrayList<>();
                    temp = new_current;
                    for (int i = new_current.length(); i < length; ++i) {
                        int cnt = (int)(count_prefix_numbers(temp + '0', n, ns) % MOD);
                        variables.add(cnt);
                        temp += '0';
                    }
                    
                    base += 1;
                    base -= new_value * power10[length - new_current.length()];
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int idx = variables.size() - 1 - i;
                        variables.set(idx, (variables.get(idx) - (int)(power10[i] % MOD) + MOD) % MOD);
                    }
                    
                    int b = (int)(base % MOD);
                    if (b < 0) b += MOD;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < variables.size(); ++i) {
                        int v = variables.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (v < 0) v += MOD;
                        variables.set(i, v);
                    }
                    
                    solve_with_sum(variables, b, answer);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Handle exact prefixes
        String prefix = "";
        long val = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            prefix += ns.charAt(len-1);
            val = val * 10 + (ns.charAt(len-1) - '0');
            
            long cnt = 1;
            String temp = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < prefix.length(); ++i) {
                char start_char = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char c = start_char; c < prefix.charAt(i); ++c) {
                    cnt += count_prefix_numbers(temp + c, n, ns);
                }
                temp += prefix.charAt(i);
            }
            cnt += prefix.length() - 1;
            cnt -= val;
            cnt %= MOD;
            if (cnt < 0) cnt += MOD;
            
            answer[0] = answer[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(cnt));
        }
        
        answer[0] = answer[0].mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007L));
        pw.println(to_string(answer[0]));
        pw.close();
    }
}
